# Policy Target

The "Policy Target" topic captures the specific performance thresholds and goals established for healthcare quality indicators within the corpus. Currently, the available evidence is limited to a single documented target. The established policy target for [[indikator-8|Indikator 8]] is set at ≥ 50% [^src1]. This metric is detailed in the 2025 AFDK report, which outlines the performance expectations for this specific indicator [^src1]. No additional policy targets or broader contextual details for other indicators are present in the current dataset.

## Claims

- Målsætningen for Indikator 8 er ≥ 50 % [^src1] (indikator-8)
